items.title: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
items.summary: Surging artificial-intelligence capabilities and declining attention spans have Chinese producers flooding the zone with short-drama films to see which ones take off.

items.title: HP partners with U.S.-blacklisted Huawei for licensing the Chinese company's WiFi tech
items.summary: BEIJING — U.S.-based personal computing and printing firm HP has signed a multi-year global agreement for licensing certain WiFi patents from Chinese telecoms giant Huawei, the companies announced Wednesday.

items.title: China needs U.S. dollars but is building a hedge against Washington’s sanctions
items.summary: BEIJING — The U.S. is threatening to cut businesses that help Iran evade sanctions off from the American financial system.

items.title: Crypto extends gains after biggest 3-day rally since 2023
items.summary: Bitcoin and crypto stocks extended their rally to start the week after the flagship cryptocurrency broke out of its trading range as investor concern over inflation and the fiscal deficit grew.

items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge shows core prices rose 3.3% annually in July
items.summary: Prices consumers pay for a variety of goods and services rose slightly in July, according to the Federal Reserve's main inflation gauge.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller leads doubters who think Bessent's bond ploys will fail
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's bond market interventions have generated a modest decline in yields along with a growing chorus of derision from those who think they won't work over the long haul and could have dangerous repercussions.
